diagnostic_criteria: Serum M-protein (IgG or IgA) 30 g/L OR urinary monoclonal protein 500 mg/24 h and/or BM clonal plasma cells 10-60%
no CRAB features attributable to plasma cell disorder

biomarkers.name: Mayo 2/20/20 risk model (M-spike >20 g/L, BM plasma cells >20%, FLC ratio >20)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Identifies risk of progression in SMM. Risk increases with 0, 1, 2, or 3 factors; this model is used to define higher-risk disease and guide monitoring, clinical trial consideration, and in some settings early intervention. Lenalidomide-based therapy has delayed progression in randomized studies (including E3A06).

biomarkers.name: High-risk cytogenetics (as per MM: t(4;14), t(14;16), del(17p), gain(1q))
biomarkers.clinical_use: Associated with higher risk of progression in SMM

biomarkers.name: Serum FLC ratio
biomarkers.clinical_use: Component of the 2/20/20 model; predicts progression. An involved/uninvolved FLC ratio =100 with involved FLC =100 mg/L is a myeloma-defining event and reclassifies to active MM.

biomarkers.name: Whole-body MRI / PET-CT
biomarkers.clinical_use: >1 focal lesion on MRI (>5 mm) is a myeloma-defining event and upstages to MM; abnormal focal imaging findings including PET-avid lesions are associated with higher progression risk

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Increased marrow plasma cell infiltrate (10-60%) and/or serum M-protein 30 g/L without end-organ damage attributable to plasma cell disorder or myeloma-defining events

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Intermediate biological state between MGUS and MM; high-risk SMM has greater genomic and microenvironmental similarity to MM. Early intervention has been studied with lenalidomide-based regimens, and anti-CD38-based combinations remain under investigation/used in selected high-risk settings and clinical trials.
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Marrow with 10-60% clonal plasma cells; no CRAB features attributable to plasma cell disorder; no >1 focal lesion >5 mm on MRI

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Clonal plasma cells with intermediate biological behavior between MGUS and MM
cellular_states_and_lineage.developmental_lineage: Mesoderm  hematopoietic/lymphoid (B-cell lineage terminally differentiated plasma cells)
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Plasma cell neoplasm with 10-60% marrow clonal plasma cells and/or serum M-protein 30 g/L, without CRAB features attributable to the plasma cell disorder and without myeloma-defining events
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Intermediate biology between MGUS and MM; additional genomic abnormalities may be present but criteria for active MM are not met. High-risk SMM has biology closer to MM.
